title: Home guide: the paper clip chain
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 14 (Home practical guide and safety card: paper clip chain (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which magnet is stronger.
equipment: About 20 paper clips the same size
safety: Keep magnets away from phones and screens
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Hang one paper clip from the magnet.
Add clips one at a time to make a chain.
Count the clips before the chain falls.
Do the same with the second magnet.
Use the same size paper clips each time: a fair test.
